<!--
WHAT THIS FILE IS
  A reference / fallback implementation of the per-arm modeling step: covariate
  baseline (elastic net) vs. ML stress test (random forest), on the team's shared
  split, writing results in the shared contract format so the dashboard/app can
  display them.

  You are NOT required to use this exact methodology. Use whatever models and
  packages you want. The only requirement is that your results land in
  `results/<arm_slug>/{scoreboard,covariates,predictions}.csv` with the columns
  shown at the bottom of this file. See
  .posit/assistant/skills/dm1-results-integration/SKILL.md for the full contract
  and for instructions your Posit Assistant can follow to wire YOUR results in.

HOW TO RUN THIS FOR A DIFFERENT ARM
  quarto render templates/quarto_workflow/model_workflow.qmd -P arm:Oligonucleotide
  quarto render templates/quarto_workflow/model_workflow.qmd -P arm:Tideglusib
-->

```{r setup}
library(tidymodels)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tibble)
library(stringr)
library(rprojroot)

arm <- params$arm
arm_slug <- tolower(arm)

outcome_of <- c(
  Mexiletine      = "myotonia_change_12wk",
  Oligonucleotide = "qmt_change_26wk",
  Tideglusib      = "tideglusib_composite"
)
outcome_col <- outcome_of[[arm]]

leaky_cols <- c(
  "patient_id", "treatment_arm", "responder",
  "myotonia_change_12wk", "qmt_change_26wk", "tideglusib_composite",
  "responder_phenotype_mex", "responder_phenotype_oligo", "responder_phenotype_tidge"
)

root <- rprojroot::find_root(rprojroot::is_git_root)
train_path <- file.path(root, "data", "derived", "split", "training_shared.csv")
test_path  <- file.path(root, "data", "derived", "split", "testing_shared.csv")
out_dir    <- file.path(root, "results", arm_slug)
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

```{r load-data}
train_full <- read_csv(train_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
test_full  <- read_csv(test_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

# `age` is dropped everywhere: age == age_at_onset + disease_duration exactly
# (confirmed across all 500 patients) -- an exact linear identity, not just a
# correlation, so keeping all three would make elastic net/stepwise rank-deficient.
predictor_cols <- setdiff(names(train_full), c(leaky_cols, outcome_col, "age"))

train_arm <- train_full |>
  filter(treatment_arm == arm) |>
  select(all_of(c(predictor_cols, outcome_col))) |>
  rename(outcome = all_of(outcome_col))

test_arm <- test_full |>
  filter(treatment_arm == arm) |>
  select(all_of(c(predictor_cols, outcome_col))) |>
  rename(outcome = all_of(outcome_col))

# Patient IDs for the predictions export (kept out of the modeling data itself)
train_ids <- train_full |> filter(treatment_arm == arm) |> pull(patient_id)
test_ids  <- test_full  |> filter(treatment_arm == arm) |> pull(patient_id)

cat(arm, "- training rows:", nrow(train_arm), " test rows:", nrow(test_arm), "\n")
```

```{r cv-and-metrics}
set.seed(2026)
folds <- vfold_cv(train_arm, v = 5)
metrics <- metric_set(rmse, mae, rsq)
```

## Covariate baseline: Elastic Net

```{r elastic-net}
rec_enet <- recipe(outcome ~ ., data = train_arm) |>
  step_novel(all_nominal_predictors()) |>
  step_unknown(all_nominal_predictors()) |>
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors()) |>
  step_zv(all_predictors()) |>
  step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())

spec_enet <- linear_reg(penalty = tune(), mixture = tune()) |>
  set_engine("glmnet")

wf_enet <- workflow() |> add_recipe(rec_enet) |> add_model(spec_enet)

tune_enet <- tune_grid(wf_enet, resamples = folds, metrics = metrics, grid = 5)
best_enet <- select_best(tune_enet, metric = "rmse")

final_enet <- finalize_workflow(wf_enet, best_enet) |> fit(train_arm)
```

## ML stress test: Random Forest

```{r random-forest}
rec_rf <- recipe(outcome ~ ., data = train_arm) |>
  step_novel(all_nominal_predictors()) |>
  step_unknown(all_nominal_predictors()) |>
  step_zv(all_predictors())

spec_rf <- rand_forest(trees = tune(), min_n = tune()) |>
  set_engine("ranger", importance = "permutation", seed = 2026) |>
  set_mode("regression")

wf_rf <- workflow() |> add_recipe(rec_rf) |> add_model(spec_rf)

tune_rf <- tune_grid(wf_rf, resamples = folds, metrics = metrics, grid = 5)
best_rf <- select_best(tune_rf, metric = "rmse")

final_rf <- finalize_workflow(wf_rf, best_rf) |> fit(train_arm)
```

## Test-set evaluation (once, locked)

```{r evaluate}
pred_enet <- predict(final_enet, test_arm)$.pred
pred_rf   <- predict(final_rf, test_arm)$.pred

score_one <- function(obs, pred) {
  tibble(obs = obs, pred = pred) |>
    summarise(
      rmse = sqrt(mean((obs - pred)^2)),
      mae  = mean(abs(obs - pred)),
      r2   = suppressWarnings(cor(obs, pred)^2)
    )
}

scoreboard <- bind_rows(
  score_one(test_arm$outcome, pred_enet) |>
    mutate(arm = arm, method = "Elastic Net", method_type = "covariate", tuned = TRUE),
  score_one(test_arm$outcome, pred_rf) |>
    mutate(arm = arm, method = "Random Forest", method_type = "ml", tuned = TRUE)
) |>
  select(arm, method, method_type, tuned, rmse, mae, r2)

scoreboard
```

## Covariates: coefficients vs. importance

```{r covariates}
coefs <- tidy(extract_fit_parsnip(final_enet), penalty = best_enet$penalty) |>
  filter(term != "(Intercept)", estimate != 0) |>
  transmute(arm = arm, method = "Elastic Net", covariate = term,
            value = estimate, value_type = "coefficient") |>
  arrange(desc(abs(value))) |>
  mutate(rank = row_number())

rf_engine <- extract_fit_engine(final_rf)
importance <- rf_engine$variable.importance
covariates_rf <- tibble(covariate = names(importance), value = unname(importance)) |>
  mutate(arm = arm, method = "Random Forest", value_type = "importance") |>
  arrange(desc(value)) |>
  mutate(rank = row_number()) |>
  select(arm, method, covariate, value, value_type, rank)

covariates_all <- bind_rows(coefs, covariates_rf)
covariates_all
```

## Predictions (test set, for the predicted-vs-observed plot)

```{r predictions}
predictions_all <- bind_rows(
  tibble(arm = arm, patient_id = test_ids, observed = test_arm$outcome,
         predicted = pred_enet, method = "Elastic Net"),
  tibble(arm = arm, patient_id = test_ids, observed = test_arm$outcome,
         predicted = pred_rf, method = "Random Forest")
)
```

## Write to the shared results contract

```{r write-outputs}
write_csv(scoreboard, file.path(out_dir, "scoreboard.csv"))
write_csv(covariates_all, file.path(out_dir, "covariates.csv"))
write_csv(predictions_all, file.path(out_dir, "predictions.csv"))

cat("Wrote results for", arm, "to", out_dir, "\n")
```
